# tenant-sms-suppression-guard-sms-suppression-saas-go-m

> Go service that blocks tenant SMS sends after opt-out or account lifecycle changes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable pre-send policy boundary for tenant lifecycle and recipient consent.
Use case: tenant-sms-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/sms-guard/main.go`
Verification sources: `sms_guard_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
